commit.subject: refactor(cli): remove the -last command variants
commit.body: Remove the shell-last, path-last, open-last, and archive-last convenience commands and their handlers, plus the now-unused resolveLastReviewOpenRun helper, to trim CLI-surface noise. The named-target commands cover the same need explicitly. README and acceptance-coverage docs updated; no behavior change to the remaining commands. (enter-last was already removed separately in the locked agent-binding work.)
